subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 3: Story – Let's tidy up! + Sound g
outcomes: I can follow the story Let's tidy up!
I can say chair, desk, floor, wall and pot.
I can hear the g sound in gate, goat and girl.

tf.s: At the start of the story, the classroom is not tidy.
tf.why: Yes! Miss Zahra says: Oh, no! Look at the classroom!

tf.s: At the end, the pens are in the pot.
tf.why: Great! The pens are in the pot.

tf.s: At the end, the pens are on the floor.
tf.why: They tidy up. The pens go in the pot.

tf.s: The book is under the chair.
tf.why: Yes! The book is under the chair.
Well done! Be tidy is the value of the story.
Yes! Sami says Let's tidy up!

tf.s: Goat starts with the f sound.
f – o – g makes the word fig.
tf.why: f-o-g makes fog. f-i-g makes fig.

tf.s: The story ends with: Thank you, children.
tf.why: Yes! The classroom is tidy at the end.

tf.s: Grapes start with the o sound.

boxes.q: Where are the crayons at the start?
boxes.why: The crayons are on the desk.
The pens are in the pot.

boxes.q: f – i – g. What's the word?
The value of the story is…

boxes.why: Pens in the pot is tidy.

hunt.q: A colour that starts with g

mcq.q: Who says Oh, no! Look at the classroom!?
mcq.why: Miss Zahra sees the mess first.

mcq.q: What sound does the gate card show?
Where is the book in the story?
mcq.why: The book is under the chair.

mcq.q: Which word is a place for pens?
mcq.why: We put pens in a pot.

mcq.q: Your crayons are on the floor. What do you say?
mcq.why: Let's tidy up! Put them away.

mcq.q: Listen: f – o – g. What's the word?
Which group of words all start with g?
mcq.why: Gate, goat and girl all start with g.

mcq.q: Why does the classroom look nice at the end?
o: The pens are on the floor.
The book is under the chair.
mcq.why: The children put things away, so it is tidy.

mcq.q: Which picture shows the story's value?
o: Children putting pens in the pot
mcq.why: Putting things away shows Be tidy.

mcq.q: What happens in the story first?
o: The pens are in the pot.
mcq.why: First the classroom is messy. Then they tidy up.
